prompt.zh-TW: 美琪的「山谷民宿」年底有這幾筆現金進出，有些比較容易混淆。每一筆屬於營業、投資還是籌資活動？
prompt.en: Mei’s Valley Guesthouse had these cash movements at year end, and some are easy to mix up. Is each one an operating, investing or financing activity?

text.en: Repaying the principal of a short-term loan
Paying the interest on the loan to the bank
Paying a cash dividend to the shareholders
Paying the income tax for the year

text.zh-TW: 把用了好幾年、已經換新的接駁廂型車賣給中古車行，收到現金
text.en: Selling the guesthouse’s old shuttle van, now replaced, to a used-car dealer for cash

text.zh-TW: 收回上個月賒帳的旅行社團費
text.en: Collecting what a travel agency owed from last month’s group booking

explanation.zh-TW: 還本金和發股利是把錢還給或分給資金提供者，屬於{{term:tm_f9a4c6md}}。利息是借錢的代價，課程模板把它列在{{term:tm_p2a7c5vk}}裡的{{term:tm_y7a34vmk}}這一列（現行 IAS 7 允許列營業或籌資，網站沿用課程的做法；IFRS 18 適用後一般企業要改列籌資，詳見名詞卡）；所得稅與收回帳款也都是營業活動。處分用了好幾年的廂型車，和當初買它一樣，屬於{{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}。
explanation.en: Repaying principal and paying dividends hand money back to, or share it out among, the providers of funds, so they are {{term:tm_f9a4c6md}}. Interest is the price of borrowing; the course template places it under {{term:tm_p2a7c5vk}}, on the {{term:tm_y7a34vmk}} line (IAS 7 currently allows operating or financing, and the site follows the course; once IFRS 18 applies, most entities will have to classify it as financing, as the term card explains). Income tax and collecting a receivable are operating too. Disposing of the long-used van, like buying it in the first place, is {{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}.
